investment_theses.thesis: Long Bitcoin volatility and quantum-hedged cold storage tokens (e.g., BTC call spreads + short XDC/tokenized settlement assets) as Google's Willow breakthrough crystallizes institutional demand for post-quantum-resistant infrastructure by Q4 2026.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: 'Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google's new Willow breakthrough'
CoinDesk: 'Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery'—cryptography risk re-priced in real-time
Crypto trending: BTC, NEAR (post-quantum-adjacent), Quant (enterprise interop) elevated
investment_theses.counter_view: Quantum threat remains theoretical; no viable quantum computer poses immediate BTC risk for 5+ years. Market may front-run hype and reverse. Regulatory crackdown on 'quantum refuge' tokens could deflate thesis.
investment_theses.expression: BTC call spreads (long $70K / short $90K calls, exp Dec 2026) + underweight XDC; alternatively, long NEAR (post-quantum narrative credibility) vs. short broad crypto beta (SOL, PENGU).

supporting_signals: CNBC: 'Berkshire shares buck market sell-off, rally to highest since Buffett said he would step down as CEO'

CoinDesk: 'Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat'—enterprise software demand structurally higher
